image_description: A top-down view of a black cast-iron skillet resting on a white stovetop. The pan contains several pieces of raw meat (likely pork chops or steaks) that are heavily coated in flour and seasoning. The handle of the skillet extends towards the bottom left, featuring a helper handle on the opposite side.

The helper handle appears somewhat thick and lacks a clearly defined hollow space underneath, looking slightly fused to the background stove grates.
The black stove grate lines in the bottom right corner fade into the background without clear geometric termination, appearing slightly warped.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of cookware (cast iron skillet) and distinguish it from other dark circular objects.
To analyze the fine-grained details of the flour coating and meat texture for signs of AI smearing or lack of high-frequency detail.
To verify the boundary sharpness between the black cast iron and the white stovetop, checking for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts.
